route.description: Semantic deep-link hint (wallet, event/{eventId}, graduation, orders, store) — mapped to each shell's local navigation; unknown/null routes are inert

createdAt.description: Clients render the relative PT-BR timestamp

notifications.description: Own rows, newest first (~30 per page)

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page; null = no further pages

count.description: 0 while the active membership is muted

enabled.description: The perfil "Notificações" switch — false mutes the badge (rows keep being written; the feed doubles as the receipt trail).

updated.description: Rows flipped unread → read by this call
